The '''Black Hole of Quintas''' was a [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]]<ref name="TEA" /> located in the [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Black Hole of Quintas was first mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''.<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square J-19.<ref name="TEA" />
